summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K announcing weekly open-market share repurchases under its existing buyback programme, executed through UBS AG as broker. Over five days (17–21 August 2026), NatWest bought over 6.4 million ordinary shares at prices ranging from 674.80p to 708.00p per share, with volume-weighted averages per day between approximately 677p and 707p. The repurchased shares will be cancelled. Following settlement, NatWest holds 178,399,737 shares in treasury and has 7,952,732,269 shares in issue, with total voting rights of 31,812,861,636. This is a routine buyback execution, not a tender offer; it reduces share count modestly. Watch for continued buyback pace and any update to the programme's remaining authorization.
